results.name: Glute Bridge With Abduction Bodyweight
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place your arms at your sides with palms facing down.
Engage your core and glutes and lift your hips towards the ceiling until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
While holding the bridge position, spread your knees apart as far as comfortable, keeping your feet flat on the floor.
Bring your knees back together, then lower your hips back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your hips remain lifted and in line with your body during the abduction movement.
Avoid letting your knees collapse inward; maintain control during the abduction movement.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you lift your hips and spread your knees, and inhaling as you lower your hips.
results.description: Glute Bridge With Abduction Bodyweight is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Goblet Kettlebell Squats
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell close to your chest with both hands, gripping at the handle.
Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hinging at your hips.
Continue lowering yourself until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, extending your hips and knees. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not cave inward during the squat.
Maintain a straight back and avoid leaning forward excessively.
Breathe in as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up to the starting position.
results.description: Goblet Kettlebell Squats is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings.

results.name: Good Mornings
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, bend your knees slightly, and place your hands beside your head with your elbows pointing outward.
Push your hips back and hinge your torso forward while keeping your back straight.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor or until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return upright, then repeat.
tips: Keep your weight balanced over your heels and midfoot.
Lower only as far as you can without rounding your back.
Push your hips backward instead of lowering into a squat.
Inhale as you hinge forward and exhale as you stand upright.
results.description: Good Mornings is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

results.name: Hack Squat Machine Squat
instructions: Position yourself on the hack squat machine with your shoulders under the pads and your feet shoulder-width apart on the foot platform. Keep your back pressed against the backrest.
Release the safety handles and slowly lower your body by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the foot platform.
Push through your heels to extend your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back pressed against the backrest throughout the exercise.
Focus on keeping your knees aligned with your toes to avoid straining your joints.
Exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower your body.
results.description: Hack Squat Machine Squat is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings.

results.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl Alternate Legs
instructions: Lie face down on the Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl machine, placing your ankles under the leg pads and holding the handles on the sides of the machine for stability. Start with both legs fully extended.
Curl one leg by bending your knee and pulling your ankle towards your glutes, keeping the other leg extended.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the movement and slowly lower your leg back to the starting position with control.
Repeat with the other leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hips pressed against the bench throughout the exercise.
Focus on engaging your hamstrings throughout the movement.
Exhale as you curl your leg and inhale as you lower it back down.
results.description: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl Alternate Legs is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Hip-Thrust in Smith Machine
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the Smith bar over your hips, with a pad.
Plant your feet flat and hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower and repeat.
tips: Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down.
Use a bar pad for comfort.
results.description: Hip-Thrust in Smith Machine is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a smith machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Quadriceps.

results.name: Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise Single Leg
instructions: Sit on the leg press and place the ball of one foot on the bottom edge of the platform.
Extend the leg with a soft knee bend.
Push the platform away by pointing your toes.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.
tips: Use a lighter weight than with two legs.
Pause at the top.
results.description: Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise Single Leg is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category.
